market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues with Nasdaq at record, oil falling, and AI momentum. Key risk: hawkish Fed and OPEC+ silence could trigger volatility. US-China summit outcome is the dominant swing factor. Expect 1-2% upside in tech, 3-5% oil downside if Iran talks progress.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structural tailwind but SoftBank IPO slowdown and Chinese probes suggest maturation. Rate environment likely higher-for-longer, pressuring valuations. Energy transition and geopolitical fragmentation create sector rotation opportunities. Media consolidation and political-media tension add structural uncertainty.
